## Chat05A / authoritative authored-text contract DECIDED (design only, 2026-10-30)

**Authoritative context:** Chat01 `PASS_SPEC` [canonical spec](https://app.notion.com/p/3fb815ae752f81d1ad64cee4f5ae9ce1); current Notion `MEMORY_REV=2026-10-30-CHAT03-EXTERNAL-SECRETS-OPTION-RESEARCH-R230`, `PLAN_REV=2026-10-30-PROраб-PARALLEL-WAVES-V15`. Verified current `main=b435e70eb88b87b3c3324ef2a2da14cdf473f229` and PR #460 `HEAD=463d75ae9181fae886ae9e198698219f95106993`. This comment determines a narrow interface; **no code, schema, hosted deployment, merge or PASS** is performed.

### Chosen source of truth

1. **Trusted ready-phrase offers:** Before a new text-capable battle is confirmed, the gameplay server persists an immutable, versioned set of available ready phrases for **A/B × attack/defense**, including each `offerId`, `phraseCatalogVersion`, canonical reference text and its server-computed Unicode-normalized word signature. A ready phrase must originate from a **server-owned** versioned catalog or a server-authenticated, pinned operator provision step. There is **no authoritative ready-phrase catalog in the current Worker**. Until it is implemented and securely snapshotted, text-vote wiring remains blocked. An offer/text/reference supplied ad hoc by a player/browser is NOT authoritative.
2. **Selection and authored text:** Existing tactical `selection` five fields remain unchanged for resolver math. A text-capable `POST /v1/battles/{battleId}/commit` additionally carries an explicit structured `textIntent` per side for attack and defense: `{offerId, finalText?}` (omit `finalText` to use the exact ready phrase). The side comes exclusively from the authenticated participant capability; the Worker validates both offerIds against this battle/side/card and the frozen catalog, verifies bounded UTF-8/Unicode text and computes the normalized comparisons. Never accept client-provided `isAuthored`, `changed`, `nextTextOrigin`, `baseText`, `baseHash` or a timestamp as proof of edit. Switching the offer with ↻ is not an edit; opening/canceling an editor is not an edit; restoring the chosen ready phrase to the same words is not an edit.
3. **Atomic commit:** Persist each side's final attack+defense text and trusted computed `wordsEdited` flags **atomically with its existing lifecycle commit and command receipt**, using existing D1 CAS/authorized write fences. The committed text/offer IDs are immutable. Matching commandId+payload replays the same receipt; altered payload cannot replace it. A fresh commandId cannot alter an already committed side. Pre-reveal opponent and spectator views expose no text/flags. Do not send authored text to telemetry or include it in logs.
4. **Canonical comparison:** Follow Chat01: case/whitespace/punctuation-only changes are no-trigger; compare meaningful ordered Unicode words, with emoji/symbol differences treated as meaningful rather than silently discarded. Use one versioned, deterministic canonicalization function in server tests and record the normalization version so subsequent catalog updates do not change the answer. Include tests for Unicode normalization, Cyrillic case, punctuation, whitespace, emoji, word boundary changes, edit-then-revert and refresh of a different ready offer. Ambiguous Unicode word-boundary cases require explicit frozen fixtures rather than guessed semantic NLP.
5. **One reveal, one vote:** At trusted reveal after both side commits, compute `edited = OR(A.attack, A.defense, B.attack, B.defense)`; `required = mechanicalOutcome === DRAW || edited`. Assign immutable trigger metadata `DRAW | AUTHORED_TEXT | BOTH | NONE`; if required and both person bindings are trusted, use existing stable `deriveSocialVoteId(battleId)`. Persist the one authoritative reveal state/receipt/event and, when required, the one `gameplay_social_votes` row **in the same guarded D1 batch/transaction**. Do not create an additional vote when both reasons apply. Repeated/restarted scheduled reveal must not duplicate anything.
6. **Required coordinated schema/lifecycle change:** Current shared `AsyncScene/Web/conflict/tactical-lifecycle.js` / `docs/conflict/tactical-lifecycle.js` restrict revealed `socialOutcome=PENDING` to DRAW only; existing Chat05A migration `0008_chat05a_people_and_votes.sql` also explicitly allows only DRAW trigger rows. Both must change together on a permitted serialized ownership window. For a non-DRAW authored edit, `mechanicalOutcome` is immutable, `socialOutcome=PENDING` and `recognizedOutcome=PENDING` until Chat05B/05C. A revealed non-DRAW with no edit keeps `socialOutcome=NONE`. Lifecycle restore and DB invariants must agree on trusted trigger metadata. A vote that is open must not be finalized by the old non-vote finalization path. Do not change the tactical resolver, outcomes calculation, economy, timers, NPC, or final recognition policy here.
7. **Legacy/fail-closed:** Old battles without server-offered phrases and trusted committed text remain on existing lifecycle, with no inferred authored trigger. Preserve current old/unbound-battle behavior for DRAW. A new text-capable battle with missing/unknown offer, stale catalog version, invalid final text, or partial text commit **rejects the operation without applying the tactical commit**. Do not silently treat unknown provenance as generated or authored.
8. **Data/privacy gate:** Gameplay user text is sensitive. It belongs only in dedicated gameplay storage with limited read access, private pre-reveal visibility and a separately approved retention/deletion + backup policy before any hosted use. Synthetic offline tests may proceed; production-like storage, migration on Cloudflare, invites, or deployment are NOT authorized by this design.
9. **Verification:** Confirm both A/B attack/defense routes, non-DRAW edit, DRAW only, BOTH, no-trigger variants, legacy restores, authorization, cross-side offer forgery, duplicate command/reload, retry after uncertain response, CAS races, concurrent reveal, single voteId, privacy before reveal and Worker/D1 restart. Validate shared source/docs mirrors and exact-head CI; independent `critical_reviewer` required for the security/persistence/shared-lifecycle changes.

**Next implementation unit:** same Chat05A PR #460 / same Codex thread, FIRST implement trusted ready-offer snapshot + atomic text commit in synthetic/local Worker/D1; verify without enabling authored-vote route. Then, after checking active file ownership, implement the smallest coherent lifecycle+DB reveal gate and integration tests. If shared lifecycle mirrors are owned elsewhere, STOP and coordinate rather than writing over them. Keep PR Draft until review. Chat05B/05C remain out of scope.

## Chat05A server-authorized vote atom

- Added an operator-only person registry with idempotent registration and immutable battle-to-person bindings for both participants.
- Added individual spectator bearer capabilities. Operator-only routes issue, rotate and revoke them by expected generation. D1 stores only SHA-256 digests, tracks generations and records digest history. Capabilities are returned once to the trusted operator; no invitations are sent.
- Participant personIds cannot receive spectator capabilities or cast ballots. The vote API accepts only `choice` and derives personId from the active spectator bearer digest. D1 rechecks capability generation when inserting.
- A revealed DRAW creates the stable `deriveSocialVoteId(battleId)` in the same D1 batch as the reveal transition, only when both trusted participant bindings exist. Legacy/unbound battles still reveal but cannot open votes.
- Database constraints enforce one vote per battle and one immutable ballot per (voteId, personId). Same-choice retries return the stored ballot; changed-choice retries conflict.
- `nextTextOrigin` defaults to unknown. Only explicit server-owned `authored` provenance can trigger the text contract. This Worker has no authoritative server-owned text source, so authored-text vote creation is not wired.

## Validation on exact HEAD

HEAD: `463d75ae9181fae886ae9e198698219f95106993`  
Base: `main@b435e70eb88b87b3c3324ef2a2da14cdf473f229`

- GitHub Actions: `private-api-local`, `sqlite-cas`, `wrangler-local-d1`, and `capture` all completed successfully on this SHA, including both duplicate check runs.
- Local workerd/D1 integration verifies participant exclusion, forged personId rejection, hash-only capability storage, revocation and reissue, repeat and changed ballot requests, concurrent ballots, stable vote creation, and legacy DRAW reveal.
- The D1 integration stops and restarts the Worker with the same persist directory, then verifies the existing voteId and ballot survive.
- Local Node contract and harness checks: 24/24 passed.
- Independent `critical_reviewer`: `PASS_STATIC_SECURITY_AND_RESTART_TEST_REVIEW` on this SHA.

## Boundary

This remains a Draft PR and is not overall Chat05A PASS or hosted/runtime acceptance. Authored-text vote creation still needs an authoritative server-owned text path. No merge, deploy, Cloudflare operation, real invitation, Chat05B, NPC, timer, economy, or UI change is included.
